mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS increased by > 0.5% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within the last month indicates a weakening labor market, which leads to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE rose by > 0.5% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over the last quarter indicates a strong demand environment, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 30% of instances where GDPC1 increased in the last quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over the last two months signals a supply-side contraction, which leads to lower corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO decreased by > 2% in the last two months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 7% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) decrease by more than 100,000 in the last month, it signals a significant labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 7% and PAYEMS decreases > 100k in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE > 7% and PAYEMS decreased by > 100k in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow by more than 1% month-over-month and housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 5%, it signals a strong demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases > 1% MoM and HOUST increases > 5%
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 30% of instances where RSAFS increased > 1% MoM and HOUST increased > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) over the last three months signals a disinflationary environment, which reduces input costs and boosts corporate margins, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 30% of instances where CPIAUCSL decreased over the last three months.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is below its 12-month moving average and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy combined with supply-side weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO is below its 12-month MA and FEDFUNDS is above 4%.
